name: kimi-float
description: Kimi desktop floating assistant (ACP client for kimi-code CLI)
author: AlbertYang

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:renderer: esbuild src/renderer/ball/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/ball/index.js --format=iife && esbuild src/renderer/chat/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/chat/index.js --format=iife && cp src/renderer/ball/index.html src/renderer/ball/style.css dist/renderer/ball/ && cp src/renderer/chat/index.html src/renderer/chat/style.css dist/renderer/chat/ && mkdir -p dist/renderer/preview && cp src/renderer/preview/index.html dist/renderer/preview/
